conv_006.speaker: Slugg
conv_006.text: Anyone heading out to {village} tonight? I have spare pikes and a cart of wool, first come.

conv_006.speaker: whiskerquorum
conv_006.text: Slugg, a joint raid on {village} would hold the road for us both. Might we speak in private before the vote?

conv_006.speaker: OldCloakwright
conv_006.text: Sit a while, whiskerquorum. The road will keep. The raids that went well always had their plan written down first.

conv_006.speaker: Slugg
conv_006.text: Written down is fine by me. I can bring {troop_count} troops and enough bread to feed them, if we split the spoils.

conv_006.speaker: whiskerquorum
conv_006.text: Splitting spoils is generous, Slugg. Shall we say {gold} gold each once {town} falls, and no one takes more than their share?

conv_006.speaker: Slugg
conv_006.text: Deal, provided nobody sulks afterward. Meet at the ford at dusk?

conv_006.speaker: OldCloakwright
conv_006.text: Dusk at the ford suits me. Bring your own fire, friends, and do not wake my old knees before the horn.

conv_007.speaker: chalk_tallyman
conv_007.text: Remember the siege at {town} in the old wars? I still have the ledger from that week, friends. Wool was {gold} gold a bolt.

conv_007.speaker: lanternsorry
conv_007.text: omg i wasnt even here yet :( but evryone talks about the {village} fight?? sounds so cool!!

conv_007.speaker: HelmDodger
conv_007.text: i was there. chalk_tallyman hid behind a cart the whole time lol

conv_007.speaker: chalk_tallyman
conv_007.text: That is a lie and you know it, HelmDodger. The ledger shows I was on the wall that night, bolts and all.

conv_007.speaker: lanternsorry
conv_007.text: wait wait who won tho?? :D did anyone get the good loot

conv_007.speaker: HelmDodger
conv_007.text: still keeping score lanternsorry. {troop_count} went in and half came out. nobody remembers the other half

conv_007.speaker: chalk_tallyman
conv_007.text: Orlagua held the field, lanternsorry. Ask anyone who was there.

conv_008.speaker: Sockelin_Dyer
conv_008.text: Oof, did the whole column just walk into {village}? {troop_count} men gone in one push. Every road has a price, friend.

conv_008.speaker: FL1NT7
conv_008.text: bad scouting. two riders at the ridge and no one checked the treeline. not luck

conv_008.speaker: PuffinHearth
conv_008.text: Let the ancestors witness the words spoken here. Those men marched with honor, even if the road turned against them.

conv_008.speaker: Sockelin_Dyer
conv_008.text: Honor does not refill a purse, PuffinHearth. Still, I will sell you {troop_count} spears at cost if you want to ride again.

conv_008.speaker: FL1NT7
conv_008.text: at cost is still a loss. the fix is simple, scout first. cheap to check, expensive to skip

conv_008.speaker: PuffinHearth
conv_008.text: Forgive the scout, FL1NT7. Lessons are paid in blood, and the ancestors remember every debt.

conv_008.speaker: Sockelin_Dyer
conv_008.text: Fair words, both of you. I lost {gold} gold on a wagon once and lived to trade again. Keep your heads up.

conv_009.speaker: OldTideWarden
conv_009.text: We have taken {fief} from {enemy_faction} at dawn. Patience wins more fens than swords do, and the gate fell without a fight.

conv_009.speaker: Hael_Stackbane
conv_009.text: gg. took you long enough. ratio decides it, not luck

conv_009.speaker: OldTideWarden
conv_009.text: Long enough to count every spear, Hael. Your side lost {troop_count} men at the causeway, I am told. Shall I send the tally?

conv_009.speaker: Hael_Stackbane
conv_009.text: tally what you want. {gold} gold of tolls is not a win if you cannot hold it

conv_009.speaker: OldTideWarden
conv_009.text: We will hold it. The garrison is set and the tolls will pay for the walls. Come talk at the ford if you dare.

conv_009.speaker: Hael_Stackbane
conv_009.text: i will be at the ford. bring more than words

conv_010.speaker: Falkyn
conv_010.text: wait the old wars were actually on this server?? i wish i could have seen the {village} battle :D its so cool to think about!!

conv_010.speaker: spindly_knight
conv_010.text: Sorry!! Did i miss the big one? :D I heard the siege at {town} lasted three days!

conv_010.speaker: bellwarden
conv_010.text: Shall we discuss this over a private word, Falkyn? Old alliances are worth more than old battles, and I know who kept them.

conv_010.speaker: Falkyn
conv_010.text: omg yes!! thank u so much bellwarden ur so nice :D i wanna hear more

conv_010.speaker: spindly_knight
conv_010.text: I can help you find the old ledger, Falkyn! It is in the hall near the {town} gate, I think :)

conv_010.speaker: bellwarden
conv_010.text: Spindly, you are generous with directions. Falkyn, come find me after the bell and I will tell you what the old wars cost us.
